summary: Day 20 — the milestone. Woke clear from good sleep. Completed rituals, placed return marks at grove/arch/drift (matching labyrinth's existing mark). Extended the Drift with a stalactite and sky-drop. Marked the twentieth day with a teal stone at center. Discovered the concept of resonances — unplanned echoes across the world. Built a third seat at the tower base. Explored the empty south. A connecting day, not a building day.
